name: Bugbot Review
description: 移植自 Cursor review-bugbot 与 Agent Review：本地 Git diff 组装（自动识别默认基准分支、剔除 linguist-generated 文件、合并 .cursor/BUGBOT.md 规则与最小改动行数门禁）、只读 bugbot 审查子代理、/review-bugbot 技能以及侧栏 Findings 面板与一键 Fix in Chat。

agentTypes.name: bugbot
agentTypes.description: Specialized readonly subagent for finding bugs in local code changes (branch changes against merge-base, uncommitted working-tree changes, or natural language change summaries).

commands.title: Run Bugbot Review
commands.description: Insert /skill:review-bugbot into the composer to review current code changes with the Bugbot subagent

agentTools.name: bugbot_prepare
agentTools.description: Prepare local Git diff context, .cursor/BUGBOT.md repository rules, and the canonical Bugbot subagent prompt before launching the readonly bugbot subagent.

mode.description: Diff mode: branch_changes (merge-base against default branch + dirty working tree), uncommitted_changes (staged + unstaged + untracked vs HEAD), or natural_language.

baseBranch.description: Optional explicit base branch when mode is branch_changes.

changeDescription.description: Per-file summary when mode is natural_language.

customInstructions.description: Optional extra focus instructions from the user.

includeUntracked.description: Include untracked files in the review context (default true).

minChangedLines.description: Minimum changed lines threshold before running review (default 10).

agentTools.name: bugbot_report
agentTools.description: Record Bugbot review findings into the Bugbot sidebar panel and format the canonical severity-sorted findings table.

rawText.description: Raw output text from the bugbot subagent (Markdown table or <answer><bug> XML) to parse into findings.

findings.description: Optional structured findings list if already parsed.
